transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the sustainment skills validation schedule. We've got four modules to place across the four training blocks: vehicle recovery procedures, load-planning procedures, radio-setup procedures, and heat-injury response. Before I can publish the final schedule, I need a written coordination control from each of you for your respective module. S-3, please speak to any changes to your training requirements. Maintenance control, signal, and medical readiness -- same for you. Let's hear what you've got.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something for the schedule. I received a visit notice this morning from a higher-headquarters evaluator who will observe the load-planning procedures module at exactly 1500 on validation day. This observation time is not yet on the battalion training slide, so we need to ensure load-planning procedures is scheduled in the 1500-1700 block to align with the evaluator's visit.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a scheduling constraint from maintenance control. The certified recovery rig required for the vehicle recovery procedures module is booked for a safety inspection from 0800 through 1200, so that module can only begin in the 1300-1500 block. I confirmed the booking with the motor pool this morning, but I should note the maintenance calendar has not yet been attached to the training packet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a scheduling constraint from signal. The radio-setup procedures module must use the signal shelter after its frequency load is completed at 0930, which makes the 1000-1200 block the first usable block. I received the programming work order from the signal shop this morning, but the completion time is not on the training schedule.
